title: Harmony Second Meeting

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, welcome back!
Anything I can get you?

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: It's been busy here, I think people stuck in the LUZ are trying to carry on as normal but you can see in their eyes they're scared.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's been busy here, I think people stuck in the LUZ are trying to carry on as normal but you can see in their eyes they're scared.

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: I think so, but I think deep down people here know that Aseptic is just a symptom of a bigger problem.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think so, but I think deep down people here know that Aseptic is just a symptom of a bigger problem.

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: It's not often I hear people with that opinion.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's not often I hear people with that opinion.

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: I probably shouldn't talk about this stuff here. You never know who's listening.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I probably shouldn't talk about this stuff here. You never know who's listening.

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: If I'd wanted to be a faceless goods dispenser I'd have become a vending machine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If I'd wanted to be a faceless goods dispenser I'd have become a vending machine.

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: As soon as I saw you, I knew you'd be one of the good ones.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: As soon as I saw you, I knew you'd be one of the good ones.

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: Well I'm sorry you see it like that, I like to think people come here because of the sparkling conversation!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well I'm sorry you see it like that, I like to think people come here because of the sparkling conversation!

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: That's exactly what an undercover CorpSec officer would say...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's exactly what an undercover CorpSec officer would say...
So is that.

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: I just don't feel like LUZ is designed to keep us safe.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I just don't feel like LUZ is designed to keep us safe.

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: I'll tell you, and anyone who might be listening to this: I've got all the proper permits. I'm allowed to be here and everything I sell is above-board. Take a look.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll tell you, and anyone who might be listening to this: I've got all the proper permits. I'm allowed to be here and everything I sell is above-board. Take a look.

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: Look I've already said too much. How do I know you're not undercover CorpSec?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look I've already said too much. How do I know you're not undercover CorpSec?

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: Do we really believe that? I think deep down people here know that Aseptic is just a symptom of a bigger problem.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do we really believe that? I think deep down people here know that Aseptic is just a symptom of a bigger problem.
Thanks.
How's business?
Of Aseptic?
And what's that?
Everything seems fine here mostly.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm sure it's fine. You can trust me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sure it's fine. You can trust me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm sure it's fine. You can trust me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm sure it's fine. You can trust me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I understand.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you talk to all your customers about this stuff?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you talk to all your customers about this stuff?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do you talk to all your customers about this stuff?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do you talk to all your customers about this stuff?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean you basically are.
I'm glad you're not.
I don't work for CorpSec!
Yeah that's fair enough.
How So?
I'm not.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Let's continue this sparkling conversation later.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let's continue this sparkling conversation later.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Let's continue this sparkling conversation later.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Let's continue this sparkling conversation later.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is public safety ever really a concern in Nivalis?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is public safety ever really a concern in Nivalis?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Is public safety ever really a concern in Nivalis?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Is public safety ever really a concern in Nivalis?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's impossible to prove I'm not.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's impossible to prove I'm not.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It's impossible to prove I'm not.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It's impossible to prove I'm not.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Distrust, perfectly designed.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But the murderer has been caught.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But the murderer has been caught.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: But the murderer has been caught.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: But the murderer has been caught.
